# Repository-local Vale vocabulary. Tracked in git; `.gitignore` un-ignores this
# one subtree of `.github/styles/`, which `vale sync` otherwise owns.
#
# Add a term here only when it is a real technical identifier the shipped
# vocabularies miss. A term useful beyond this repository belongs upstream in
# nolte/vale-style instead -- `vocab-drift-audit` checks for entries that have
# since been accepted there and can be dropped.
#
# ruleset: GitHub's own product term for a branch or tag rule set. The `s?`
# covers the plural -- a Vale vocabulary entry is a whole-word pattern, so
# `[Rr]uleset` alone leaves `rulesets` reported as a spelling error.
[Rr]ulesets?
#
# Sigstore: the signing project whose key format `skopeo generate-sigstore-key`
# produces and `containers-policy.json` `sigstoreSigned` verifies.
# keyless: Sigstore's own term for signing with a short-lived workflow identity
# instead of a long-lived key.
Sigstore
[Kk]eyless
